      * inputs have correct shapes at decode time.

codex
**Root Cause**
- The standard/imported path is wired in the expected order: ONNX slots `6/7` map to `pastKey`/`pastValue`, and the SameDiff wrapper builds `Q, K, V, attnBias, pastKey, pastValue` for the native op. See [MultiHeadAttention.kt](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-import/samediff-import-onnx/src/main/kotlin/org/nd4j/samediff/frameworkimport/onnx/definitions/implementations/MultiHeadAttention.kt:54), [MultiHeadAttention.kt](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-import/samediff-import-onnx/src/main/kotlin/org/nd4j/samediff/frameworkimport/onnx/definitions/implementations/MultiHeadAttention.kt:130), and [OnnxMultiHeadAttention.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/nd4j-backends/nd4j-api-parent/nd4j-api/src/main/java/org/nd4j/linalg/api/ops/impl/transforms/custom/OnnxMultiHeadAttention.java:145).
- The native op does use `block.width()`, but it immediately nulls empty/scalar placeholders, so scalar `0.0` inputs in slots `4/5` are not treated as real `pastKey`/`pastValue`. See [onnx_multi_head_attention.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/ops/declarable/generic/nn/onnx_multi_head_attention.cpp:72).
- The actual DSP divergence was in Triton fused-attention lowering: when ONNX MHA arrives with 3D GQA K/V `[B, seqK, kvHeads * headDim]` and no real 4D past-KV tensor, several DSP paths fell back to `numKvHeads = numQHeads`, and some code still assumed optional input `4` was `past_key`. That miscompiled SmolDocling-style attention.

**Fix**
- I changed DSP/Triton lowering to scan optional inputs `3..N` for a real 4D past-KV tensor instead of hardcoding slot `4`: [TritonIRBuilder_sections.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/gpu/TritonIRBuilder_sections.cpp:781), [TritonIRBuilder_module.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/gpu/TritonIRBuilder_module.cpp:4124), [TritonGraphBackend_compile.cu](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/gpu/TritonGraphBackend_compile.cu:409).
- I changed 3D GQA handling to infer `numKvHeads = kvHidden / headDim` from K/V shape instead of assuming Q-head count: [TritonIRBuilder_module.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/gpu/TritonIRBuilder_module.cpp:2391), [TritonIRBuilder_module.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/gpu/TritonIRBuilder_module.cpp:5924), [TritonIRBuilder_sections.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/gpu/TritonIRBuilder_sections.cpp:809).
- I added a regression test for 3D GQA ONNX MHA without direct `past_key`/`past_value`: [TritonGraphBackendTest.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/TritonGraphBackendTest.java:7095).

**Verification**
- `git diff --check` passed.
- I did not run a build or tests because this repo requires a user-specified build command and none was provided. Send the exact build command you want used for validation, and I’ll run that plus the targeted `platform-tests` regression.

**Root Cause**
- The standard/imported path is wired in the expected order: ONNX slots `6/7` map to `pastKey`/`pastValue`, and the SameDiff wrapper builds `Q, K, V, attnBias, pastKey, pastValue` for the native op. See [MultiHeadAttention.kt](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-import/samediff-import-onnx/src/main/kotlin/org/nd4j/samediff/frameworkimport/onnx/definitions/implementations/MultiHeadAttention.kt:54), [MultiHeadAttention.kt](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-import/samediff-import-onnx/src/main/kotlin/org/nd4j/samediff/frameworkimport/onnx/definitions/implementations/MultiHeadAttention.kt:130), and [OnnxMultiHeadAttention.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/nd4j-backends/nd4j-api-parent/nd4j-api/src/main/java/org/nd4j/linalg/api/ops/impl/transforms/custom/OnnxMultiHeadAttention.java:145).
- The native op does use `block.width()`, but it immediately nulls empty/scalar placeholders, so scalar `0.0` inputs in slots `4/5` are not treated as real `pastKey`/`pastValue`. See [onnx_multi_head_attention.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/ops/declarable/generic/nn/onnx_multi_head_attention.cpp:72).
- The actual DSP divergence was in Triton fused-attention lowering: when ONNX MHA arrives with 3D GQA K/V `[B, seqK, kvHeads * headDim]` and no real 4D past-KV tensor, several DSP paths fell back to `numKvHeads = numQHeads`, and some code still assumed optional input `4` was `past_key`. That miscompiled SmolDocling-style attention.

**Fix**
- I changed DSP/Triton lowering to scan optional inputs `3..N` for a real 4D past-KV tensor instead of hardcoding slot `4`: [TritonIRBuilder_sections.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/gpu/TritonIRBuilder_sections.cpp:781), [TritonIRBuilder_module.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/gpu/TritonIRBuilder_module.cpp:4124), [TritonGraphBackend_compile.cu](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/gpu/TritonGraphBackend_compile.cu:409).
- I changed 3D GQA handling to infer `numKvHeads = kvHidden / headDim` from K/V shape instead of assuming Q-head count: [TritonIRBuilder_module.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/gpu/TritonIRBuilder_module.cpp:2391), [TritonIRBuilder_module.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/gpu/TritonIRBuilder_module.cpp:5924), [TritonIRBuilder_sections.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/gpu/TritonIRBuilder_sections.cpp:809).
- I added a regression test for 3D GQA ONNX MHA without direct `past_key`/`past_value`: [TritonGraphBackendTest.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/TritonGraphBackendTest.java:7095).
